# Ezekiel 34 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**2** "Son-of-man, prophesy against the-shepherds-of Israel; prophesy and-say to-them — to-the-shepherds: Thus says the-Lord YHWH: Woe [to]-the-shepherds-of Israel who have-been-feeding themselves! Should-not the-shepherds feed the-flock?

**3** The-fat you-eat and-the-wool you-clothe-yourselves-[with]; the-fattened-ones you-slaughter — the-flock you-do-not-feed.

**4** The-weak you-have-not-strengthened, and-the-sick you-have-not-healed, and-the-broken you-have-not-bound-up, and-the-driven-away you-have-not-brought-back, and-the-lost you-have-not-sought; and-with-force you-have-ruled-them and-with-harshness.

**5** And-they-were-scattered for-lack-of a-shepherd, and-they-became food for-every beast-of the-field, and-they-were-scattered.

**6** My-flock wandered over-all the-mountains and-upon every high hill, and-over all the-face-of the-earth My-flock was-scattered, and-there-was-none searching and-none seeking.

**7** Therefore, shepherds, hear the-word-of YHWH:

**8** "As-I-live," declares the-Lord YHWH, "surely because My-flock has-become a-prey and-My-flock has-become food for-every beast-of the-field because-of-lack-of a-shepherd, and-My-shepherds did-not-search-for My-flock, and-the-shepherds fed themselves and-My-flock they-did-not-feed—"

**9** Therefore, shepherds, hear the-word-of YHWH:

**10** Thus says the-Lord YHWH: "Behold-Me against the-shepherds, and-I-will-require My-flock from-their-hand and-cause-them-to-cease from-feeding the-flock, and-the-shepherds will-not-feed themselves anymore; and-I-will-deliver My-flock from-their-mouth, and-they-will-not-be food for-them."

**11** For thus says the-Lord YHWH: "Behold-Me — I-Myself — and-I-will-search-for My-flock and-seek-them-out.

**12** As-a-shepherd seeks-out his-flock on-the-day he-is among his-sheep [that-are]-scattered, so I-will-seek-out My-flock; and-I-will-deliver-them from-all the-places where they-were-scattered on-a-day-of cloud and-thick-darkness.

**13** And-I-will-bring-them-out from the-peoples and-gather-them from the-lands and-bring-them to their-own-land; and-I-will-feed-them on the-mountains-of Israel, by-the-streams and-in-all the-inhabited-places-of the-land.

**14** In-good-pasture I-will-feed-them, and-on the-high-mountains-of Israel will-be their-grazing-ground; there they-will-lie-down in-good grazing-ground, and-rich pasture they-will-graze-on upon-the-mountains-of Israel.

**15** I-Myself will-feed My-flock and-I-Myself will-cause-them-to-lie-down," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**16** "The-lost I-will-seek and-the-driven-away I-will-bring-back and-the-broken I-will-bind-up and-the-sick I-will-strengthen; but-the-fat and-the-strong I-will-destroy — I-will-feed-them with-justice."

**17** "And-as-for-you, My-flock," thus says the-Lord YHWH, "behold-Me judging between sheep and-sheep, between-the-rams and-the-goats.

**18** Is-it-too-small for-you that the-good-pasture you-graze, and-the-rest-of your-pastures you-trample with-your-feet? And-the-clear waters you-drink, and-the-rest you-foul with-your-feet?

**19** And-My-flock — the-trampling-of your-feet they-graze, and-the-fouling-of your-feet they-drink."

**20** Therefore, thus says the-Lord YHWH to-them: "Behold-Me — I-Myself — and-I-will-judge between fat sheep and-lean sheep.

**21** Because with-side and-with-shoulder you-push and-with-your-horns you-gore all the-weak-ones until you-have-scattered-them abroad,

**22** I-will-save My-flock, and-they-will-not-be a-prey anymore; and-I-will-judge between sheep and-sheep.

**23** And-I-will-raise-up over-them one shepherd, and-he-will-feed-them — My-servant David — he will-feed-them, and-he will-be to-them a-shepherd.

**24** And-I, YHWH, will-be to-them God, and-My-servant David [will-be] prince in-their-midst. I, YHWH, have-spoken.

**25** And-I-will-make with-them a-covenant-of peace and-cause evil beasts to-cease from the-land, and-they-will-dwell in-the-wilderness securely and-sleep in-the-forests.

**26** And-I-will-make-them and-the-surroundings-of My-hill a-blessing, and-I-will-cause-the-rain to-come-down in-its-season — rains-of blessing they-will-be.

**27** And-the-tree-of the-field will-give its-fruit and-the-earth will-give its-increase, and-they-will-be on-their-land securely; and-they-will-know that I [am] YHWH when-I-break the-bars-of their-yoke and-deliver-them from-the-hand-of those-who-enslaved-them.

**28** And-they-will-not-be a-prey anymore to-the-nations, and-the-beast-of the-earth will-not-devour-them; and-they-will-dwell securely, and-none [will]-make-[them]-afraid.

**29** And-I-will-raise-up for-them a-planting-place-of renown, and-they-will-not-be anymore those-taken-by famine in-the-land, and-they-will-not-bear anymore the-reproach-of the-nations.

**30** And-they-will-know that I, YHWH their-God, [am] with-them, and-they [are] My-people, the-house-of Israel," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**31** "And-you [are] My-flock, the-flock-of My-pasture — you-[are] human, I [am] your-God," declares the-Lord YHWH.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **34:2**: Ro'im — 'shepherds' — in the ancient Near East, 'shepherd' was a common royal title. This oracle indicts Israel's entire political leadership, not merely priests.

- **34:16**: The reversal of verse 4 is deliberate: every failure listed there is now corrected by YHWH's own action. God does what Israel's leaders refused to do.

- **34:23**: Avdi David — 'My servant David' — this messianic shepherd figure echoes the Davidic covenant of 2 Samuel 7, projecting the ideal king into the eschatological future.

— EMET
